parameters.name: AccessDomain
parameters.description: The backend domain name to be modified for FULLNAT address translation.

parameters.name: AccessIp
parameters.description: The backend IP address to be modified for FULLNAT address translation.

parameters.name: AccessPort
parameters.description: The backend port to be modified for FULLNAT port mapping. Valid values: **1** to **65535**.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: performs a dry run without modifying the FULLNAT entry. The system checks the AccessKey pair, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and the required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
- **false** (default): sends a Normal request. If the check succeeds, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the FULLNAT entry is modified.

parameters.name: FullNatEntryDescription
parameters.description:
The new description of the FULLNAT entry.

The description can be empty or 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: FullNatEntryId
parameters.description: The ID of the FULLNAT entry to be modified.

parameters.name: FullNatEntryName
parameters.description:
The new name of the FULLNAT entry.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: FullNatTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the FULLNAT table to which the FULLNAT entry belongs.

parameters.name: IpProtocol
parameters.description:
The protocol type of the Redirection Port. Valid values:

- **TCP**: forwards TCP packets. 
- **UDP**: forwards UDP packets.

parameters.name: NatIp
parameters.description: The NAT IP address to be modified.

parameters.name: NatIpPort
parameters.description: The frontend port to be modified for FULLNAT port mapping. Valid values: **1** to **65535**.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs), also known as the network interface controller (NIC), to be modified.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPC NAT gateway to which the FULLNAT entry belongs.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
